I need everyone focusing fire on that monster!|audio = VoidcoreWave45-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 45 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Soul Stealer''' is a mini-boss that appears in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. It has high health but it walks rather slowly. It has two abilities: #The first ability is ''Curse Tower''. When performed, the '''Soul Stealer''' curses a tower, making it unable to attack until the '''Soul Stealer''' is dead. Ability usage for the cursed tower is also disabled, but any passive ability may still work. Additionally, it will steal the soul of the tower and summon in a [[Soul]] enemy. Only 20 towers can be cursed by a '''Soul Stealer''' at once, with cursed towers that were sold not being included in this limit. In cases where the ability is used when the limit is reached, it will only summon in a [[Soul]]. #The second ability, ''Summon'', makes the '''Soul Stealer''' summon in three [[Soul]]s and one [[Void Eye]]. During this, it will also become a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy for 12 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''The Soul Stealer is one of the highest ranking in the Void Army, and is considered by Void Caster to be invaluable. She created the Soul Stealer to manage the growth of her army, and will only send it out when she feels victory could be achieved. They manage the souls who roam the Void, as well as claim them from whatever realms their rifts begin to tear into. They lack personality and are more like a drone who serves a specific task and does so without fanfare. It is considered ‘lame’, but it does not seem to care.''" ==Appearance== The '''Soul Stealer''' has a large, golden lock for a head. It has a single, large eye in the center, with a pupil resembling a key hole. Its chest has numerous gold rectangular pieces attached to it. The '''Soul Stealer''' also has a deep purple hood over its head, adorned with golden buttons. It has no legs, rather having a single body segment where the legs would be, all tied up in numerous belts, while its arms are separated from the torso. One of its arms has a golden key attached to it while the other has a lock. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, preferably ones with hidden detection due to its summons and it becoming [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] every time it uses ''Summon'' are recommended. Such towers include the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Juggernaut]], [[Engineer]] or [[Mercenary Base]]. **The [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to make towers which cannot detect it, like the [[Ranger]], to be able to do so. *The '''Soul Stealer''' can curse towers, which will make them do nothing until the '''Soul Stealer''' is killed. **If an important tower was cursed by the '''Soul Stealer''', it is recommended to sell and place it down again if possible, as this will remove the curse. **The [[Medic]] cannot protect towers from being cursed. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Soul Stealer''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} SoulStealerCA.png|'''Soul Stealer''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} DefeatSoulStealerBadge.png|'''Soul Stealer''' on its badge. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SoulStealerIconIG.png|'''Soul Stealer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *When first added in [[v2.0.0]], the '''Soul Stealer''' had a third ability where it would turn into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy at 25% of its health. This ended up getting removed in [[v2.1.0]]. **This was seemingly replaced by having it incorporated into its ''Summon'' ability, as since the same update it now gives it [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] temporarily for 12 seconds. *The '''Soul Stealer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Soul Stealer''' added. *'''19 June 2026''' - [[v2.1.0]] **''Summon'' now gives it [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] for 12 seconds every time it is used. **''Summon'' cooldown decreased from 40 to 30. **''Rift Diffraction'' removed. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health increased from 300,000 to 375,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. **Speed decreased from 1.75 to 1.65. **''Summon'' changed. ***Number of summoned [[Soul]]s decreased from 4 to 3. ***[[Void Eye]] is no longer [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. ==Notes== {{Voidcore|[[Unknown Boss]] & [[Void Cultist]]|Wave 44|Soul Stealer|Wave 45|[[Heavy Voidling]]|Wave 46}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
